how to use: Each line under names is  "address": "the name to show".
The map shows the place's normal name, and this name instead once you zoom in to at least the zoom below (the map goes up to 18).
Write the address as the place search shows it (1522 E 53rd St). If two places share an address, put the place's name first: "Joseph Regenstein Library, 1100 E 57th St".
A place that has no name on the map yet gets one, shown only close in (from zoom 17).
Keep the quotes and the commas between lines; the last line has no comma. No en or em dashes in names.

After a change: commit it. The site rebuilds the map names when it deploys; tools/build_landmarks.py does the same on a PC and reports a typo or an address it cannot find. The iPhone app takes the names with its next build.
